{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Salad|Salad]] | [[Cookbook:Vegan cuisine|Vegan cuisine]]

This '''tomato salad''' can be served as a side dish, on toast, or in another salad.

==Ingredients==
*750 [[Cookbook:Gram|grams]] (26 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomato]]
*3–4 small [[Cookbook:Onion|onions]]
*3 cloves of [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]]
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
*[[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]]
*[[Cookbook:Olive Oil|Olive oil]]

==Procedure==
# [[Cookbook:Chopping|Chop]] the onions really fine. [[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] them for about 4 minutes.
# While they are boiling, cut the tomatoes in quarters, and remove the juicy centre. You can use the centres for tomato soup or throw them away.
# [[Cookbook:Knife Skills|Dice]] tomatoes just as finely as the onion.
# Peel and [[Cookbook:Mince|mince]] the garlic.
# When the onions are done boiling, put them in a [[Cookbook:Sieve|sieve]] or something comparable to drain the water.
# Once onions, tomatoes and garlic are all finely chopped, put all of them in a bowl, and shake/stir.
# Add a bit of olive oil and salt and pepper to taste.
